mapper.sql: id,connector_id AS connectorId,item_type AS itemType,external_id AS externalId,title,item_url AS itemUrl,excerpt,attributes_json AS attributesJson,raw_json AS rawJson,remote_updated_at AS remoteUpdatedAt,synced_time AS syncedTime,created_time AS createdTime,updated_time AS updatedTime

sql.if: AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR external_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_connector_item(connector_id,item_type,external_id,title,item_url,excerpt,attributes_json,raw_json,remote_updated_at,synced_time) VALUES(#{connectorId},#{itemType},#{externalId},#{title},#{itemUrl},#{excerpt},#{attributesJson},#{rawJson},#{remoteUpdatedAt},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE item_type=VALUES(item_type),title=VALUES(title),item_url=VALUES(item_url),excerpt=VALUES(excerpt),attributes_json=VALUES(attributes_json),raw_json=VALUES(raw_json),remote_updated_at=VALUES(remote_updated_at),synced_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_connector_item WHERE connector_id=#{connectorId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_connector_item WHERE connector_id=#{connectorId}
SELECT item_type AS itemType, COUNT(*) AS total FROM t_connector_item WHERE connector_id=#{connectorId} GROUP BY item_type ORDER BY total DESC, item_type
mapper.sql: id,connector_id AS connectorId,connector_item_id AS connectorItemId,knowledge_base_id AS knowledgeBaseId,source_id AS sourceId,document_id AS documentId,content_hash AS contentHash,remote_updated_at AS remoteUpdatedAt,ingest_status AS ingestStatus,last_ingest_time AS lastIngestTime,last_ingest_message AS lastIngestMessage
mapper.select: SELECT connector_item_id AS itemId, ingest_status AS ingestStatus, document_id AS documentId, content_hash AS contentHash FROM t_connector_item_binding WHERE connector_id=#{connectorId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_connector_item_binding(connector_id,connector_item_id,knowledge_base_id,source_id,document_id,content_hash,remote_updated_at,ingest_status,last_ingest_time,last_ingest_message) VALUES(#{connectorId},#{connectorItemId},#{knowledgeBaseId},#{sourceId},#{documentId},#{contentHash},#{remoteUpdatedAt},#{ingestStatus},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,#{lastIngestMessage}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_id=VALUES(source_id),document_id=VALUES(document_id),content_hash=VALUES(content_hash),remote_updated_at=VALUES(remote_updated_at),ingest_status=VALUES(ingest_status),last_ingest_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,last_ingest_message=VALUES(last_ingest_message)
mapper.select: SELECT id, external_id AS externalId, item_type AS itemType, attributes_json AS attributesJson FROM t_connector_item WHERE connector_id=#{connectorId} ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM t_connector_item WHERE connector_id=#{connectorId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
